text: ArtCraft Bridge 是一个面向 DSH 网页客户端的创作软件自动化插件，通过工具和同源 HTTP API 将 ArtCraft 家族应用接入 Harness。它可以检查 CLI 安装状态、运行应用命令、向运行中的应用发送控制通道指令，并提供文件读写、应用能力目录、处理配方和交付质量检查。长时间渲染等任务可通过后台任务接口启动、查询和取消；另有独立技能提供者加载随包技能。适合希望在 DSH 对话或自建前端中编排图像、视频、音频及文档应用的用户。需要本机安装对应 ArtCraft 应用及 CLI，并按需配置其路径；文件操作由调用者指定绝对路径。

ArtCraft Bridge connects creative apps to DSH through agent tools and an HTTP API. It runs app CLIs, controls supported running apps, and provides file operations and delivery checks. Frontends can start and track background jobs. Install the relevant apps and CLIs locally.
想让 DSH 帮我通过命令行处理图片或视频素材。
有没有办法从对话里控制正在运行的剪辑软件？
让我的前端能通过 HTTP 启动并跟踪长时间的媒体渲染任务。
我想在 DSH 里检查导出的视频或文档是否符合交付规格。
I want an agent to run commands in my installed creative apps.
Can I trigger and track a long rendering job from my own frontend?
ArtCraft Bridge 的功能「运行应用 CLI」：通过 artcraft_cli 选择家族应用并传入命令行参数，返回运行结果；长时间任务可交由 HTTP 后台任务接口处理。
ArtCraft Bridge 的功能「控制运行中的应用」：向支持的 JSON 控制通道发送方法与参数，取得应用返回结果；可选择预设应用端口或指定端口。
ArtCraft Bridge 的功能「浏览器后台任务」：前端可提交应用与参数启动任务，再查询任务状态或取消任务，适用于耗时渲染和批处理。
ArtCraft Bridge 的功能「交付质检」：对指定产物运行应用探针并按可选平台和类型核对规则，返回检查项、判定及修复提示。
ArtCraft Bridge 的文件接口要求调用方提供绝对路径（或绝对 base 加相对路径）；本插件不替调用者决定项目目录。

@ninkch/dsh-artcraft README · ArtCraft Bridge：**Drive the open-source ArtCraft studio apps — PhotoCraft, FilmCraft, EffectCraft — from DeepSeek Harness, in chat or from your own UI.** [English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) `@ninkch/dsh-artcraft` · a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) plugin · Apache-2.0 ---

@ninkch/dsh-artcraft README · Why this exists：[ArtCraft](https://getartcraft.com/apps) is a family of **fourteen** free, fair-source reinventions
of Adobe's studio tools, written from scratch in pure Rust: **PhotoCraft** (Photoshop),
**VectorCraft** (Illustrator), **FilmCraft** (Premiere Pro), **LightCraft** (Lightroom),
**PdfCraft** (Acrobat), **EffectCraft** (After Effects), **DesignCraft** (InDesign),
**WordCraft** (Word), **DeckCraft** (PowerPoint), **GridCraft** (Excel), **CADCraft** (AutoCAD),
**SoundCraft** (Pro Tools), **FigCraft** (Figma) and **SolidCraft** (3D parametric CAD).
They share one superpower that most desktop
apps don't have: **every menu item, slider and dialog is a command**, and the exact same commands
can be driven from a headless CLI, a JSON control channel, or an MCP server. The apps were built
for agents from day one.

@ninkch/dsh-artcraft README · Why this exists：This plugin brings that surface into DeepSeek Harness, so an AI agent can *operate* the apps —
not just talk about them:

@ninkch/dsh-artcraft README · Why this exists：- **In chat** — ten agent tools let any Harness session check the toolchain, run CLI commands,
  send control-channel commands to a running app, do bridged file operations, run delivery QC,
  and consult a per-app capability catalog.
- **A bundled craft skill pack** — eleven skills (`artcraft-ops`, `artcraft-shot-language`,
  `artcraft-edit-rhythm`, `artcraft-color-light`, `artcraft-sound-design`, `artcraft-motion-vfx`,
  `artcraft-delivery-qc`, `artcraft-style-bible`, `artcraft-film-study`, `artcraft-batch-pipeline`,
  `artcraft-multicam`) teach the agent *how* to drive the suite fluently, which effect to reach for,
  how to design shot language, pacing, grade and sound, how to lock a consistent look across
  episodes, how to break a film down into evidence, how to run batches, and how to cut multicam.
  They ship inside the plugin and load on demand (English index: `skills/README.md`).
- **In the browser** — a same-origin HTTP API (`/artcraft/api/*`) that any Harness web UI can call,
  no CORS, no keys. It was built for [无限画布 / infinite-canvas](../dsh-infinite_canvas/README.md),
  a node-based AI short-drama storyboard canvas, but any

@ninkch/dsh-artcraft README · Why this exists：A typical AI short-drama loop looks like this: generate storyboard frames with a model →
batch color-grade and sharpen them in PhotoCraft → render an animated title in EffectCraft →
assemble the final cut in FilmCraft with grading, mixing and burned-in subtitles → export H.264.
Every step after "generate" runs through this plugin, headless.

@ninkch/dsh-artcraft README · How it fits together：```
┌──────────────── DeepSeek Harness web UI (browser) ────────────────┐
│   e.g. infinite-canvas: ① upload assets  ② start jobs  ③ fetch   │
└─────────────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────┘
                              ▼  same-origin fetch, no CORS

Everything runs locally. No cloud round-trips, no accounts, no telemetry.

@ninkch/dsh-artcraft README · Requirements：- **DeepSeek Harness** (desktop), any platform the Harness supports.
- **ArtCraft apps** — grab what you need from [getartcraft.com](https://getartcraft.com/apps)
  or the [storytold GitHub releases](https://github.com/storytold). The portable/installer builds
  ship the CLI binaries on Windows and Linux (`photocraft-cli.exe` …); macOS ships them as a
  separate notarized zip. Versions tested: PhotoCraft 0.9, FilmCraft 0.8, EffectCraft (early).
- Nothing else. No Python, no FFmpeg — the ArtCraft apps bring their own codecs.

`bins.*.found` and you're done.

@ninkch/dsh-artcraft README · Driving it from chat：The plugin registers ten tools. The agent composes them, so plain language works:

> *"Color-grade every PNG in `demo/media` with a soft S-curve and smart sharpening at 80, put the
> results in `demo/out/graded`."*

Behind that sentence the agent will typically do:

```
artcraft_cli  { bin:"photocraft", args:["batch","--actions","demo/craft/grade.json",
                                        "--in","demo/media","--out","demo/out/graded"] }
```

@ninkch/dsh-artcraft README · Driving it from the browser：Same-origin HTTP, JSON in and out. The workhorse pattern is the **job lifecycle** — start, poll,
fetch — which keeps long renders off the request cycle:

                              "args":["render","--comp","Main",
                                      "--out","demo/out/intro.mp4","demo/craft/intro.ecproj"],
                              "outputs":["demo/out/intro.mp4"] }

scrubbing a cut — start the desktop app with its control channel and speak to it live:

```

@ninkch/dsh-artcraft README · The control channel: drive a running app：Time accepts `seconds`, `frame` or `timecode` (internally FilmCraft counts ticks at
254,016,000,000/s). `filmcraft-cli commands` lists the 650+ engine commands; the protocol is
documented in [filmcraft/docs/control-protocol.md](https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/blob/main/docs/control-protocol.md).
EffectCraft listens the same way on its own port (default 9877); VectorCraft defaults to 7979
and LightCraft to 7980 (both built into `artcraft_control`'s `app`). The remaining apps pick
dynamic ports: start them with `app --port PORT`, then pass `port` to `artcraft_control`. Each
app's control surface is described in the `artcraft_apps` catalog.

@ninkch/dsh-artcraft README · Working with 无限画布 (infinite-canvas)：The two plugins are decoupled — they meet only on HTTP and the disk layout. The canvas:

1. syncs its generated assets (IndexedDB blobs) into `<project>/media/`,
2. starts PhotoCraft/FilmCraft/EffectCraft jobs with per-project files in `<project>/craft/`,
3. fetches finished renders from `<project>/out/` back into its asset library.

If you're building a similar front end, mirror that contract: project slug as folder name, keep
the `media · craft · out` triad, and everything composes.

@ninkch/dsh-artcraft README · Working with 无限画布 (infinite-canvas)：| Endpoint | Use it for |
|---|---|
| `GET /artcraft/api/apps` | 14-app capability catalog + command-family stats (a "capabilities" panel) |
| `GET /artcraft/api/skills` | The 11 bundled skills with their reference files (a "skills" section) |
| `GET /artcraft/api/live` | Control-channel liveness (live tuning vs headless runs) |
| `GET /artcraft/api/qc?path=…&platform=…` | Artefact QC — chain it right after an export and show a PASS/WARN badge; on failure surface `checks[].fix` verbatim |
| `POST /artcraft/api/job` + `GET ?id=` | Long-job lifecycle (render/export/batch) |

@ninkch/dsh-artcraft README · Recipes：**Final cut without a browser recorder** — the canvas exports its storyboard as a
Final Cut Pro 7 XML (`xmeml`) or CMX3600 EDL into `demo/craft/timeline.xml`; FilmCraft imports
it, links media from `demo/media/`, and exports H.264 (hardware NVENC on Windows), ProRes, DNxHR
with EBU R128 loudness normalization and burned-in captions. Interchange is where FilmCraft's
automation really pays off — EDL/XML are plain text your pipeline already knows how to write.

@ninkch/dsh-artcraft README · Recipes：**Animated titles as code** — EffectCraft projects (`.ecproj`) are versioned JSON, so a model can
write one outright or fill a template. Render to MP4/ProRes — ProRes 4444 with alpha drops
straight onto a FilmCraft track as a graphics layer — or export **Lottie** and play it inline in
a web UI.

@ninkch/dsh-artcraft README · Troubleshooting：- **`bins.*.found: false`** — check the path forms above; the CLI must exist next to the app
  (or be on `PATH`). Changes to `artcraft.config.json` apply on the next request.
- **404 on `/artcraft/api/*`** — the bundle isn't registered with the profile (see Setup) or the
  Harness hasn't been restarted since registration. `artcraft_status` from chat is the quick probe.
- **Control channel refused** — the app must be running with `--control <port>`; the channel is
  loopback-only and unauthenticated, so nothing else will answer on that port.
- **A job hangs** — `GET /artcraft/api/job` lists everything with logs; cancel by id. Plugin
  reloads kill all child jobs by design.
- **"需要绝对路径" errors** — pass absolute paths (chat: the conversation workspace; canvas: the
  project folder), or a `base` absolute directory + relative `rel`.

@ninkch/dsh-artcraft README · Security & trust model：The HTTP surface has **no authentication** and rides on the Harness web server, which listens on
loopback only — treat the port as trusted-local and don't expose it to a network; put a reverse
proxy with auth in front if you must. Child processes are locked to the thirteen allow-listed
family CLIs; the control channel only ever dials `127.0.0.1`.

@ninkch/dsh-artcraft README · Publishing：This plugin is published to npm as **`@ninkch/dsh-artcraft`** (scoped packages publish with
`npm publish --access public`). To consume it, add the package name to your Harness profile's
`dependencies` and `dsh.profile.bundles` (see Setup) — `pnpm install` in the profile does the
rest. For local development, swap the dependency for a `"link:<path-to-this-repo>"` instead.
The three places that must agree on the package name are the profile `package.json`
(dependency + bundles) and this repo's `cordis.patch.yml`.

@ninkch/dsh-artcraft README · Publishing：GitHub: this repository is self-contained; `README.md` is English-first with a
[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) companion.

@ninkch/dsh-artcraft README · License：This plugin (`@ninkch/dsh-artcraft`): **Apache-2.0** — see [LICENSE](LICENSE). It ships none of the
ArtCraft apps' code; it only drives their public automation surfaces (headless CLI + JSON control
channel). The ArtCraft apps themselves are separate projects by the ArtCraft team — the apps' own
licenses apply to the apps.

@ninkch/dsh-artcraft README · 为什么做这个：[ArtCraft](https://getartcraft.com/apps) 是一套用纯 Rust 从零重写的免费公平源代码（fair source）
Adobe 对标工具，共 **14 个应用**：**PhotoCraft**（Photoshop）、**VectorCraft**（Illustrator）、
**FilmCraft**（Premiere Pro）、**LightCraft**（Lightroom）、**PdfCraft**（Acrobat）、
**EffectCraft**（After Effects）、**DesignCraft**（InDesign）、**WordCraft**（Word）、
**DeckCraft**（PowerPoint）、**GridCraft**（Excel）、**CADCraft**（AutoCAD）、**SoundCraft**
（Pro Tools）、**FigCraft**（Figma）、**SolidCraft**（三维参数化 CAD）。它们有一个大多数桌面软件都不具备的共同基因：**每个菜单项、
滑块、对话框都是一条命令**，而同一套命令既能从无头 CLI 调用，也能走 JSON 控制通道或 MCP——
这些 App 从第一天起就是为 agent 设计的。

@ninkch/dsh-artcraft README · 为什么做这个：- **对话里** —— 十个 Agent 工具，任何 Harness 会话都能检查工具链、执行 CLI 命令、向运行中的
  App 发控制通道命令、做桥接文件操作、跑交付质检、查每个应用的能力目录。
- **随插件分发的技能包** —— 十一个技能（`artcraft-ops`、`artcraft-shot-language`、
  `artcraft-edit-rhythm`、`artcraft-color-light`、`artcraft-sound-design`、`artcraft-motion-vfx`、
  `artcraft-delivery-qc`、`artcraft-style-bible`、`artcraft-film-study`、`artcraft-batch-pipeline`、
  `artcraft-multicam`）教 agent 怎么调得顺、什么时候用哪种效果、镜头语言与节奏怎么设计、
  影调/声音/交付怎么把关、跨集一致性怎么锁、怎么把一部片拆成可回溯的证据、怎么做批量流水线、
  怎么剪多机位。随包内置、按需加载（英文索引见 `skills/README.md`）。
- **浏览器里** —— 同源 HTTP API（`/artcraft/api/*`），任何 Harness 前端都能直接调用：无 CORS、
  无密钥。它为 [无限画布 / infinite-canvas](../dsh-infinite_canvas/README.md)（节点式 AI 短剧
  分镜画布）而建，但任何前端都可用。
- **路径由调用方决定** —— 本插件只是桥接，不持有数据目录：对话调用默认落在当前对话工作空间
  （或提示词指定的任意位置）；画布调用则写在自己项目目录下。

@ninkch/dsh-artcraft README · 为什么做这个：典型的 AI 短剧闭环：模型生成分镜图 → PhotoCraft 批量调色锐化 → EffectCraft 渲染动态片头 →

| `POST /artcraft/api/job` · `GET ?id=…` · `POST /artcraft/api/job/cancel` | 任务生命周期，含产物探测与日志尾部 |
| `POST /artcraft/api/control` | 控制通道同步调用（`app` 或 `port`） |
| `GET /artcraft/api/apps[?id=…]` | 家族能力目录（14 应用 + 命令族统计） |
| `GET /artcraft/api/qc?path=…[&platform=…][&kind=…]` | 交付质检：平台规格核对 + 修复建议 |
| `GET /artcraft/api/skills` | 内置技能包清单（11 技能 + 各自参考文件） |
| `GET /artcraft/api/live[?ports=app:port,…]` | 控制通道活性（哪些 App 正开着） |
| `POST /artcraft/api/discover` | 家族安装探测 + 配置自动修复 |
| `GET /artcraft/api/update/check` · `POST /artcraft/api/update/apply` | 插件自更新 |

@ninkch/dsh-artcraft README · 控制通道：驱动正在运行的 App：时间可传 `seconds` / `frame` / `timecode`（FilmCraft 内部以每秒 254,016,000,000 tick 计）。
`filmcraft-cli commands` 列出全部 650+ 引擎命令；协议详见
[filmcraft/docs/control-protocol.md](https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/blob/main/docs/control-protocol.md)。
EffectCraft 同族协议，端口默认 9877；VectorCraft 默认 7979、LightCraft 默认 7980（`artcraft_control`
的 `app` 已内置）。其余应用端口动态：以 `app --port PORT` 启动后，`artcraft_control` 传 `port`
直连即可（协议同族）。每个应用的控制面详见 `artcraft_apps` 能力目录。

@ninkch/dsh-artcraft README · 与无限画布（infinite-canvas）协作：两个插件零代码耦合，只在 HTTP 和磁盘布局上会合。画布侧：

1. 把生成的资产（IndexedDB Blob）同步进 `<项目>/media/`；
2. 以 `<项目>/craft/` 里的工程文件发起 PhotoCraft / FilmCraft / EffectCraft 任务；
3. 从 `<项目>/out/` 取回成片入库。

如果你要做类似的前端，照此契约即可：项目名作文件夹名、保持 `media · craft · out` 三件套，
一切自然组合。

**前端可直接用的新端点**（画布/自建 UI 都能调）：

@ninkch/dsh-artcraft README · 与无限画布（infinite-canvas）协作：| 端点 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `GET /artcraft/api/apps` | 14 应用能力目录 + 命令族统计（做"能力面板"） |
| `GET /artcraft/api/skills` | 内置 11 个技能清单（做"技能"区块） |
| `GET /artcraft/api/live` | 控制通道活性（哪些 App 正开着，决定"实时调"还是"无头跑"） |
| `GET /artcraft/api/qc?path=…&platform=…` | 产物质检（交付前自动把规格核对挂在导出流程后） |
| `POST /artcraft/api/job` + `GET ?id=` | 长任务生命周期（渲染/导出/批处理） |

建议的前端流程：导出完成 → 调 `/api/qc` 展示 PASS/WARN 徽标 → 不通过时把 `checks[].fix` 直接展示给用户。

@ninkch/dsh-artcraft README · 常用配方：**告别浏览器录屏的成片** —— 画布把分镜导出为 FCP7 XML（`xmeml`）或 CMX3600 EDL 写入
`demo/craft/timeline.xml`；FilmCraft 导入后自动关联 `demo/media/`，导出 H.264（Windows 走
NVENC 硬编）、ProRes、DNxHR，附 EBU R128 响度归一与字幕烧录。交换格式是 FilmCraft 自动化
最划算的地方 —— EDL/XML 是纯文本，你的流水线本来就会写。

**动画字幕即代码** —— EffectCraft 工程（`.ecproj`）是版本化 JSON，模型可以直接写、也可以填
模板。渲染成 MP4/ProRes —— 带 alpha 的 ProRes 4444 可直接叠进 FilmCraft 当图形层 —— 或导出
**Lottie**，在网页里内联播放。

@ninkch/dsh-artcraft README · 排错：- **`bins.*.found: false`** —— 核对上面的路径写法；CLI 必须在 App 目录旁（或在 `PATH`）。
  改 `artcraft.config.json` 下一次请求即生效。
- **`/artcraft/api/*` 返回 404** —— bundle 没在 profile 注册（见"安装"），或注册后没重启。
  对话里调 `artcraft_status` 是最快探针。
- **控制通道连接失败** —— App 必须以 `--control <端口>` 启动；通道仅回环且无鉴权，端口上
  不会有别的应答者。
- **任务卡住** —— `GET /artcraft/api/job` 带日志列出全部任务，按 id 取消；插件重载会按设计
  终止所有子任务。
- **"需要绝对路径"报错** —— 传绝对路径即可：对话用当前工作空间下的路径，画布用项目目录下的
  路径（或 `base` 绝对目录 + 相对 `rel`）。

@ninkch/dsh-artcraft README · 发布：本插件已发布到 npm：**[`@ninkch/dsh-artcraft`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ninkch/dsh-artcraft)**
（带 scope 的包发布时需要 `npm publish --access public`）。使用时把包名加进 Harness profile 的
`dependencies` 与 `dsh.profile.bundles`（见"安装"），profile 里跑一次 `pnpm install` 即可。
本地开发则把依赖换成 `"link:<本仓库路径>"`。包名必须一致的三处：profile 的 `package.json`
（依赖 + bundles）、本仓库的 `cordis.patch.yml`。

GitHub 上传本仓库即可：`README.md` 英文优先，附
[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) 对照。

@ninkch/dsh-artcraft README · 发布：**发版走 npm Trusted Publishing**（GitHub Actions OIDC —— 无令牌、无 OTP）：

会校验发布提交在 main 上且版本对齐，然后自动发布。发版流程与红线见
